## 702b86fcc04c

**Reproduced validator defect.** Generator SHA-256
`3c8f591a1a54b6a7f39887ca74493513291942110c44b7509e98f73dc303975e`;
executed rule hash `17282641828d`.

The documented grammar requires separated singleton color-2 objects and at
least one larger color-2 distractor. A grid containing only one 2x2 color-2
block has no singleton and is therefore outside that documented generator
domain, yet `self_check` returns `[]`. This lets malformed examples enter later
stages and makes the trivial rival “recolor every color-2 cell” plausible on the
accepted input.

The exact grid, validator result, supported Racket output, rival output, hashes,
and apply command are retained in
`checks/audit/702b86fcc04c/counterexample.json`; raw apply inputs/receipt are in
the same directory. The target was not modified. Recommended local repair:
count 4-connected color-2 components, require at least one size-1 component and
at least one component of size greater than one, then test separation of each
singleton from every other nonzero cell.

audits.resolution_reason:
Audited source repo/generators/702b86fcc04c/generator.py SHA256 3c8f591a1a54b6a7f39887ca74493513291942110c44b7509e98f73dc303975e. 
Generator SHA-256 3c8f591a1a54b6a7f39887ca74493513291942110c44b7509e98f73dc303975e; executed canonical rule 17282641828d. Ticket ticket-1abc5c31ca4bbe87; pinned seed 116104b011645043cd294171a25f332c419022e6df828c1ebb77696beb6c2ad4.

The ordinary sampler uses a horizontal two-cell red distractor. The shortcut "recolor a red cell when it has no horizontal red neighbor" fits four ordinary demonstrations drawn with int(pinned_seed[:16], 16), indices 0–3.

A lawful 8×8 query replaces that pair with a vertical pair at (3,1)/(4,1), retaining two isolated red singletons and the nonred distractor. Red component sizes are [1,1,2]; the singletons remain separated from other nonzero cells, and self_check returns []. Actual Racket preserves both vertical-pair cells as 2, while the shortcut predicts 3.

The sole targeted probe executed 10 Racket labels in 3.69 seconds: four demonstrations, the query, and five canonical pairs. Canonical labels match. The rival fits only 4/5 canonical pairs, so this is a generated-distribution coverage gap, not a canonical-fitting ambiguity or a label error. The current sampler cannot emit this vertical distractor.

Evidence: checks/tickets/ticket-1abc5c31ca4bbe87/result.json, checks/tickets/ticket-1abc5c31ca4bbe87/witness.json, checks/tickets/ticket-1abc5c31ca4bbe87/racket.json, checks/tickets/ticket-1abc5c31ca4bbe87/probe.py, and checks/tickets/ticket-1abc5c31ca4bbe87/command.json.

A useful repair is to vary larger-component orientation and shape and teach true component size rather than horizontal isolation. This return contains no target repair, prevalence estimate, peer battery, audit clearance, approval change or training admission.
